'''Cybloc XII''' was the twelfth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cybloc]] in [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]]. The small moon had a rotation period which was almost synchronous with its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], resulting in a long day-night cycle.

The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] established a base on Cybloc XII which served as a major trade hub between the New Republic and the neutral worlds in Meridian Sector. It was the home base of [[Transit Galactic Shipping]]. Most of the population was killed when [[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]] and [[Dzym]] released the [[Death Seed]] plague throughout Meridian Sector in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. As the plague spread there was considerable looting by various fringe elements using protective clothing to avoid infection.
